brass_battery_works.name: Brass Battery Works
brass_battery_works.observation: Under the water-driven hammers a brass sheet is beaten into a basin in forty strokes, and the shed rings from dawn to dusk.
brass_battery_works.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Brass Wares from brass and charcoal, using water hammer drives, wrought iron and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

salt_glazed_stoneware.name: Salt-Glazed Stoneware
salt_glazed_stoneware.observation: The potter throws a shovel of salt into the fire-mouth; a white cloud rolls out, and the jugs come out coated in hard, pitted glaze.

gun_barrel_founding.name: Gun Barrel Founding
gun_barrel_founding.observation: The founders pour bell bronze round a clay core, while in the next shed smiths hoop iron staves into a barrel like a cask.

high_warp_tapestry_workshops.name: High-Warp Tapestry
high_warp_tapestry_workshops.observation: Six weavers sit behind the upright warp, working from the painted cartoon hung beside them; one hunting scene takes two years.

drawn_cane_beads.name: Drawn Cane Beads
drawn_cane_beads.observation: Two glassmen walk apart down the long gallery, drawing a hot bubble into a hollow cane a hundred feet long, later chopped into beads.

cast_iron_shot_firebacks.name: Cast-Iron Wares
cast_iron_shot_firebacks.observation: The furnace pours straight into sand: round shot for the gunners, a fireback with the lord's arms, a three-legged pot for the kitchen.

pewter_alloy_standards.name: Pewter Standards
pewter_alloy_standards.observation: The pewterers' wardens assay every dish; fine metal takes the rose touch, and the lead-heavy lay metal is marked as lesser.

gig_mill_napping.name: Gig Mills
gig_mill_napping.observation: Water turns the drum of teasels against the wet cloth, and one man and a boy raise the nap that once took four.

potash_saltpetre_works.name: Saltpetre Works
potash_saltpetre_works.observation: The boilers pour wood-ash lye into the nitre liquor, and white crystals grow on the rods as the vats cool.
potash_saltpetre_works.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Saltpetre from nitrates, wood-ash lye, timber and freshwater, using clay and wrought iron. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

corned_powder_mills.name: Corned Powder Mills
corned_powder_mills.observation: The damp powder cake is pressed through a sieve into grains, which burn fast and even and keep dry on the cart.
corned_powder_mills.social_consequence: Powder grows stronger and safer to carry, and now and then a stamping mill and its crew vanish in one flash.
corned_powder_mills.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Black Powder from saltpetre, sulfur, charcoal and freshwater, using water hammer drives, stone and timber. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

mainspring_fusee_clocks.name: Spring-Driven Clocks
mainspring_fusee_clocks.observation: A coiled steel spring in a brass drum drives the little clock, and the cone-shaped fusee evens its pull from fully wound to run down.
mainspring_fusee_clocks.ability_reason: A coiled spring evened by the fusee lets a clock shrink to a table or a pocket; fine spring steel and small gears become a trade of their own.

turpentine_rosin_distilling.name: Turpentine and Rosin
turpentine_rosin_distilling.observation: The pine gum is boiled in a copper still; turpentine drips from the worm, and rosin hardens in the pot.

bolt_blank_forging.observation: The smith heads a bolt blank in the swage and hands it on to be threaded; a hundred are made to one pattern.

clear_crystal_glass.name: Clear Crystal Glass
clear_crystal_glass.observation: Purified plant ash and a pinch of manganese make a glass so clear that a goblet seems to hold the wine in air.
clear_crystal_glass.ability_reason: Colourless glass carries fine lenses, mirrors and goblets; the glassmakers' secret becomes a treasury for the city that guards it.

polychrome_tin_glaze.name: Polychrome Tin Glaze
polychrome_tin_glaze.observation: On the white tin glaze the painter lays blue, green, yellow and orange, and the kiln fixes them bright.

nut_blank_forging.observation: Square and six-sided nut blanks are punched from hot bar, leaving iron enough round the hole for a spanner's bite.

screw_tap_and_die.name: Taps and Dies
screw_tap_and_die.observation: The die plate cuts the thread on the bolt and the tap cuts it in the nut, and any bolt from the box now fits any nut.

liquation_silver_parting.name: Liquation Parting
liquation_silver_parting.observation: Copper cakes laced with lead are heated slowly; the silver-bearing lead sweats out and runs into the channel below.

iron_plate_hammer_mills.name: Plate Hammer Mills
iron_plate_hammer_mills.observation: The trip hammer beats a glowing bloom out flat, and the plate goes to the armourer or the pan maker.

needle_lace.name: Needle Lace
needle_lace.observation: With only a needle and linen thread the lacemaker builds a flower in the air, stitch on stitch, over a parchment pattern.

mercury_tin_mirrors.name: Mercury-Tin Mirrors
mercury_tin_mirrors.observation: Tin foil is laid on a stone, flooded with quicksilver and the glass slid over it; the mirror-makers' hands shake by forty.
mercury_tin_mirrors.social_consequence: Clear mirrors grace every fine house, and the silverers are slowly poisoned by the quicksilver.

filigree_cane_glass.name: Filigree Glass
filigree_cane_glass.observation: White canes laid side by side are picked up on a hot bubble and twisted, so the goblet is laced with white spirals.

flyer_spinning.observation: The flyer twists the yarn and the bobbin winds it in one motion, and the treadle leaves both the spinner's hands free to draft.
flyer_spinning.ability_reason: Spinning and winding at once doubles the yarn a spinner makes in a day; cloth waits less on the spinners.

cochineal_scarlet.name: Cochineal Scarlet
cochineal_scarlet.observation: A pound of dried insects from the new lands dyes more scarlet than ten pounds of the old kermes grain.

rolled_metal_strip.name: Rolled Metal Strip
rolled_metal_strip.observation: Two hardened rolls turned by a crank press silver into strip of one thickness, ready for the coin blanks.

bobbin_lace.name: Bobbin Lace
bobbin_lace.observation: Forty bobbins click across the pillow as the lacemaker plaits her threads round the pins.

flat_rod_mine_pumps.name: Flat-Rod Pumps
flat_rod_mine_pumps.observation: A wheel in the valley rocks a line of wooden rods half a mile up the hill, and the pumps in the shaft draw water day and night.
flat_rod_mine_pumps.ability_reason: Water power carried by rods to the shaft keeps deep workings dry, and mines reach ore that bucket and horse could never drain.

mercury_ore_amalgamation.name: Amalgamation Yards
mercury_ore_amalgamation.observation: Mules tread crushed silver ore with quicksilver and salt in open yards for weeks, until the silver is drawn into the amalgam.
mercury_ore_amalgamation.social_consequence: Poor silver ore becomes worth mining, and the yard hands and their mules breathe mercury.

copperas_works.name: Copperas Works
copperas_works.observation: Heaps of pyrite stones lie weathering in the rain, and the green liquor that runs from them is boiled down to copperas.

sugar_loaf_refining.name: Sugar Refining
sugar_loaf_refining.observation: Raw sugar is boiled with lime and ox blood, poured into clay cones and drained until the loaf comes out white.

screw_cutting_lathe.name: Screw-Cutting Lathe
screw_cutting_lathe.observation: The lead screw carries the cutter along the work, so each turn of the spindle cuts the thread one pitch farther.

soft_paste_porcelain.name: Soft-Paste Porcelain
soft_paste_porcelain.observation: White clay and ground glass fire into a translucent ware; it chips more easily than the eastern porcelain, but it is our own.

kelp_alkali.name: Kelp Alkali
kelp_alkali.observation: Along the shore the kelp burners rake seaweed in stone pits, and the fused grey cake goes to the glassmakers and soapmakers.

stocking_knitting_frame.name: Stocking Frame
stocking_knitting_frame.observation: The frame knits a whole row at once on hundreds of bearded needles; a stocking that took a week by hand is done in a day.
stocking_knitting_frame.ability_reason: A machine that knits whole rows at once proves that cloth can be made by mechanism; hosiery becomes a trade of rented frames.
stocking_knitting_frame.social_consequence: Stockings are cheap for all; hand knitters lose their living, and frame renters depend on the hosier.

slitting_mills.name: Slitting Mills
slitting_mills.observation: Plate passes between grooved cutting rolls and comes out as a bundle of nail rods, which the nailers once split by hand.

ribbon_engine_loom.name: Ribbon Engine Loom
ribbon_engine_loom.observation: One weaver pulls the bar and sixteen ribbons are woven at once, and the ribbon weavers of the town petition to have the engine burned.

indigo_vat_dyeing.name: Indigo Vat Dyeing
indigo_vat_dyeing.observation: Indigo cakes from the new lands go into the fermenting vat, and the cloth comes out green and turns blue in the air.

cementation_blister_steel.name: Blister Steel
cementation_blister_steel.observation: Bars of iron are packed in charcoal in stone chests and baked for a week; they come out blistered and hard enough for edge tools.
cementation_blister_steel.ability_reason: Steel made by the chestful rather than by the smith's luck puts good edges on files, springs and blades everywhere.

coal_fired_glass_furnace.name: Coal-Fired Glasshouses
coal_fired_glass_furnace.observation: When the woods ran short the glassmakers turned to coal, and they cover their pots so the soot never touches the glass.

wooden_tub_bellows.name: Wooden Tub Bellows
wooden_tub_bellows.observation: Two great wooden tubs rise and fall on the water wheel's cams, and they never crack or rot like the leather bellows.

blue_white_tin_glaze.name: Blue-and-White Tin Glaze
blue_white_tin_glaze.observation: The painters copy the blue patterns of the eastern porcelain on white tin glaze, and the town's ware sells across the sea.

tin_glazed_wall_tiles.name: Painted Wall Tiles
tin_glazed_wall_tiles.observation: A workshop paints three thousand tiles a week, windmills and ships, to line the kitchens and hearths of the merchants' houses.

powder_rock_blasting.name: Powder Blasting
powder_rock_blasting.observation: The miner drills a hole into the face, charges it with powder and a straw fuse, and shouts before the rock splits.

dark_bottle_glass.name: Dark Bottle Glass
dark_bottle_glass.observation: The coal-fired glasshouse turns out dark green bottles thick enough to be stacked on their sides in a cellar.

carroted_fur_felting.name: Carroted Fur Felt
carroted_fur_felting.observation: The hatter brushes the fur with orange mercury salts so it felts tighter; in time the hatters' hands tremble and their minds wander.
carroted_fur_felting.social_consequence: Fine hats for every head, and a trade whose masters are known for their shaking hands.

recrystallised_saltpetre.name: Refined Saltpetre
recrystallised_saltpetre.observation: The saltpetre is dissolved in hot water, skimmed and cooled three times, and each crop of crystals comes out whiter.

veneer_marquetry.name: Veneer Marquetry
veneer_marquetry.observation: The saw cuts walnut into leaves as thin as card, and the cabinetmaker lays them into flowers of pale and dark wood.

stoved_varnish_ware.name: Stoved Varnish Ware
stoved_varnish_ware.observation: Iron trays are painted with black varnish and baked in an oven, coat after coat, until they shine and never rust.

gear_cutting_engine.name: Gear-Cutting Engine
gear_cutting_engine.observation: The index plate turns the blank one tooth at a time under the rotary file, and every wheel in the clock has teeth alike.

mordant_printed_calico.name: Mordant-Printed Calico
mordant_printed_calico.observation: Printers stamp mordant patterns on cotton with wooden blocks, and the madder bath brings them up in fast red and purple.

lead_crystal_glass.name: Lead Crystal
lead_crystal_glass.observation: A dose of red lead in the batch makes a glass so heavy and bright that its cut facets flash like jewels.
lead_crystal_glass.ability_reason: Lead-fluxed glass cuts, sparkles and bends light truly; the lens makers and the cutters both build on it.

hollander_beater.name: Hollander Beater
hollander_beater.observation: A roll of knives turns in the long tub, and the rags become pulp in hours instead of the day the stampers took.

coal_tar_pitch.name: Coal Tar and Pitch
coal_tar_pitch.observation: Coal smoulders in closed ovens, and the tar that runs off is boiled to pitch for the ships' seams.

cast_plate_glass.name: Cast Plate Glass
cast_plate_glass.observation: The molten glass is poured on an iron table and rolled flat, and grinders and polishers work a month on one great pane.
cast_plate_glass.ability_reason: Glass poured and ground flat makes panes and mirrors of any size; windows fill rooms with light, and mirrors fill galleries.

reverberatory_furnace.name: Reverberatory Furnace
reverberatory_furnace.observation: The coal burns on its own grate, and the low arched roof throws the flame down on the ore, so the fuel never touches the metal.

coal_grading.observation: The coalmaster sorts his seams: smokeless coal for the maltster, bright coal for the smith, dense and sulphur-poor coal for the furnace.

steam_suction_pump.name: Fire Engine Pump
steam_suction_pump.observation: Steam fills the vessel, a dash of cold water condenses it, and the vacuum sucks the mine water up the pipe.
steam_suction_pump.ability_reason: Fire does the work of a team of horses at the mine: for the first time burning fuel lifts water directly.

precipitated_iron_blue.name: Iron Blue Pigment
precipitated_iron_blue.observation: A colour-maker's spoiled batch of blood-salt and iron left a deep blue powder, and now the painters buy it by the ounce.

sand_flask_casting.name: Sand Flask Casting
sand_flask_casting.observation: The moulder rams damp sand round a pattern in two iron boxes, lifts it out and pours a pot with walls as thin as a finger.

coke_firing.observation: Coal is baked in heaps away from air until only grey coke is left, strong enough to carry the furnace charge without crushing.
coke_firing.ability_reason: Coke frees ironmaking from the forests: furnaces grow larger, and iron can be made wherever coal lies.

atmospheric_beam_engine.name: Atmospheric Engine
atmospheric_beam_engine.observation: The great beam nods twelve times a minute over the shaft, and each stroke lifts ten gallons of water from the deep workings.
atmospheric_beam_engine.ability_reason: Air pressing on a piston gives the first dependable engine, and mines go deeper than any wheel can drain.

refractory_furnaces.observation: Linings of fireclay brick hold the furnace heat for months, so the blast need not stop for relining.

rolled_tinplate.name: Rolled Tinplate
rolled_tinplate.observation: Iron plate is rolled thin, pickled and dipped in molten tin, and the tinsmith makes it into pans, lanterns and boxes.

graphite_clay_crucibles.name: Graphite Crucibles
graphite_clay_crucibles.observation: Crucibles of fireclay mixed with plumbago stand the white heat of the brass melt twenty times before they crack.

flying_shuttles.observation: The weaver jerks the picking cord and the shuttle flies across on its wheels; one man now weaves broadcloth alone.
flying_shuttles.ability_reason: One weaver weaves twice as fast and twice as wide; yarn, not looms, becomes the bottleneck of the cloth trade.

globe_oil_of_vitriol.name: Vitriol in Glass Globes
globe_oil_of_vitriol.observation: Sulphur and nitre burn in a pan inside a great glass globe over water, and the fumes dissolve into oil of vitriol.

zinc_retort_distillation.name: Zinc Distillation
zinc_retort_distillation.observation: Calamine and charcoal heated in sealed clay pots give off zinc vapour, which runs down an iron pipe into water.
zinc_retort_distillation.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Refined Zinc from zinc ore and coal, using ceramic crucibles and refractory bricks. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

metal_casting_feed_design.observation: The founder sets a riser over the thickest part of the mould, so the last metal to freeze draws from it and not from the casting.

steel_refining.observation: Blister steel is melted in a closed clay crucible in a coke fire and poured into ingots of one temper throughout.
steel_refining.ability_reason: Cast steel of even temper makes springs, razors and cutting tools reliable enough to build machines with.

fused_silver_plate.name: Fused Silver Plate
fused_silver_plate.observation: A thin sheet of silver fused onto a copper ingot rolls out with it, so a candlestick looks like silver and costs a quarter as much.

plaster_mould_slip_casting.name: Slip Casting
plaster_mould_slip_casting.observation: Liquid clay poured into a plaster mould leaves a thin, even skin as the plaster drinks the water, and every teapot comes out alike.
plaster_mould_slip_casting.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Pottery Plaster Molds from gypsum, timber and freshwater, using timber and clay; and Dry Cast Stoneware from stoneware body, freshwater and pottery plaster molds, using pottery plaster molds and timber; and Stoneware Vessels from dry cast stoneware and timber, using refractory bricks and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

fantail_windmills.name: Fantail Windmills
fantail_windmills.observation: A small wheel at the back of the cap turns the whole mill into the wind, and the miller need not climb out in a squall.

lead_chamber_acid.name: Lead Chamber Acid
lead_chamber_acid.observation: Sulphur and nitre burn in a room lined with lead sheet; the acid collects on the floor by the ton, at a tenth of the price of globe acid.
lead_chamber_acid.ability_reason: Cheap acid by the ton opens bleaching, metal cleaning and new alkali trades.
lead_chamber_acid.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Sulfuric Acid from sulfur, nitrates and freshwater, using lead sheets and timber. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

cylinder_carding.name: Carding Engine
cylinder_carding.observation: Toothed cylinders turn against each other and deliver an endless gauze of carded cotton, gathered into a soft rope.

copperplate_calico.name: Copperplate Calico
copperplate_calico.observation: An engraved copper plate prints a whole pastoral scene on the cotton in lines finer than any wood block can cut.

transfer_printed_ware.name: Transfer-Printed Ware
transfer_printed_ware.observation: The engraving is printed on tissue, the tissue pressed on the fired ware, and the pattern stays when the paper is washed away.

creamware.name: Creamware
creamware.observation: Pale, light earthenware under a cream glaze fills the tables of shopkeepers who could never afford porcelain.

vitriol_linen_sours.name: Vitriol Sours
vitriol_linen_sours.observation: The bleachers sour the linen for a day in weak oil of vitriol instead of a week in buttermilk.

wove_paper_moulds.name: Wove Paper
wove_paper_moulds.observation: A mould of woven brass wire leaves no laid lines, and the printer's finest type sits on a smooth, even sheet.

tested_waterwheel_efficiency.name: Tested Water Wheels
tested_waterwheel_efficiency.observation: The engineer's model wheel turns in a trough under a measured head, and the breastshot wheel beats the undershot by half.

iron_blowing_cylinders.name: Blowing Cylinders
iron_blowing_cylinders.observation: Bored iron cylinders worked by the wheel push a steady blast, and the furnace makes half again as much pig.

multi_spindle_spinning.observation: A girl turns one wheel and draws the carriage back, and eight, then sixteen, spindles spin at once.
multi_spindle_spinning.ability_reason: One spinner working many spindles multiplies the yarn a cottage can make; weavers are fed at last.

fast_madder_red.name: Fast Madder Red
fast_madder_red.observation: The cotton goes through oil, dung, alum and madder baths twenty times over a month, and comes out a red that never fades.

roller_water_frame.name: Water Frame
roller_water_frame.observation: Pairs of rollers turning ever faster draw the roving thin, and flyers twist it into a hard warp; the frame runs on the stream.
roller_water_frame.ability_reason: Machines spin warp as strong as any hand's, and spinning leaves the cottages for mills beside the water.

separate_condenser_engine.name: Separate Condenser
separate_condenser_engine.observation: The steam is led off to a cold vessel apart, so the cylinder stays hot, and the engine burns a quarter of the coal for the same work.
separate_condenser_engine.ability_reason: Keeping the cylinder hot cuts the fuel by three quarters, so engines pay even where coal is dear.

textile_calendering.observation: The cloth is wound between heavy heated rolls until it shines like glazed paper.

spring_shutter_sails.name: Spring Sails
spring_shutter_sails.observation: The sail is a frame of shutters on springs; a gust opens them, and the miller no longer reefs canvas in the rain.

hard_tin_alloy.name: Hard Tin Alloy
hard_tin_alloy.observation: Tin hardened with antimony is rolled and spun into teapots that shine like silver and hold no lead.

mule_spinning.observation: The mule's carriage runs out drawing and twisting, then runs back winding, and its yarn is fine enough for muslin.
mule_spinning.ability_reason: Fine, strong yarn by machine lets the realm weave the sheerest cloth, once bought only from the East.

belt_power_transmission.observation: Leather belts run from pulleys on the line shaft to each machine, and shifting a belt stops one without stopping all.

rotative_steam_engine.name: Rotative Engine
rotative_steam_engine.observation: Sun-and-planet wheels turn the beam's nodding into steady turning, and the engine drives a mill where there is no stream.
rotative_steam_engine.ability_reason: Rotary steam power frees mills from rivers: works can stand beside the coal, the market and the hands.

clay_pyrometer_gauge.name: Clay Pyrometer
clay_pyrometer_gauge.observation: A clay cylinder shrinks in the kiln as the heat rises; the potter reads it in a brass gauge and knows his firing to a degree.

puddling_furnace.name: Puddling Furnace
puddling_furnace.observation: The puddler stirs the boiling pig iron with a long bar through the furnace door until it thickens into a spongy ball of wrought iron.
puddling_furnace.ability_reason: Coal can now make bar iron as well as pig; wrought iron is freed from charcoal and made by the ton.
puddling_furnace.social_consequence: Iron grows cheap and plentiful; the puddlers burn out by forty in the heat of the furnace door.

grooved_bar_rolls.name: Grooved Bar Rolls
grooved_bar_rolls.observation: The puddled bloom is squeezed through grooved rolls, pass after pass, into bars of set size fifteen times faster than under the hammer.

chlorine_bleaching.name: Chlorine Bleach
chlorine_bleaching.observation: Linen that lay for months on the bleaching green is white in a day in the chlorine liquor, though the bleach house stinks.

roller_calico_printing.name: Roller Printing
roller_calico_printing.observation: Engraved copper rollers print a continuous web of calico, and one machine does the work of forty block printers.

yarn_tension_control.observation: Weights and brakes hold the warp at one tension as it is beamed, and the finished cloth lies flat.

double_acting_engine.name: Double-Acting Engine
double_acting_engine.observation: Steam drives the piston both ways, and the parallel linkage keeps the rod true as the beam swings.

jig_filed_gunlocks.name: Jig-Filed Gunlocks
jig_filed_gunlocks.observation: Each lock plate is filed to a hardened steel jig, so a tumbler from any lock fits any other of the same pattern.

textile_braiding.observation: Bobbins circle the mandrel on the braiding table and lay a round cord for stays and laces.

salt_cake_soda.name: Salt-Cake Soda
salt_cake_soda.observation: Salt and oil of vitriol make salt cake, roasted with chalk and coal into black ash and leached to soda; the acid fumes kill the fields downwind.
salt_cake_soda.ability_reason: Alkali from salt instead of plant ash frees soap and glass from the kelp shores, and chemistry becomes an industry.
salt_cake_soda.social_consequence: Soap and glass grow cheap; the works' acid smoke blights the country around them.

bone_ash_porcelain.name: Bone-Ash Porcelain
bone_ash_porcelain.observation: Calcined ox bone in the paste makes a white, strong, translucent ware that stands the kiln better than soft paste.

yarn_count_standards.observation: Yarn is sold by its count, how many hanks of set length weigh a pound, so spinner and weaver speak one language.

metal_annealing_control.observation: The wire drawer anneals his coils in a closed pot for a set time, watching the colour, so the next draw does not snap.

mechanical_clutches.observation: A lever slides the dog clutch out of mesh, and one machine stands still while the shaft keeps turning.
mechanical_clutches.production_contract: Finite workshop batches forge dog clutches that let one mill or hoist shaft stand while another turns, paying wrought iron, a little steel and work. Lathe-turned friction clutches come later with centre-lathe assembly; imported finished parts remain usable.

pressure_vessels.observation: Boilermakers rivet wrought-iron plates into a vessel and test it with water pressure before any fire is lit.
